paper.title: MobileSteward: Integrating Multiple App-Oriented Agents with Self-Evolution to Automate Cross-App Instructions
paper.central_claim: 提出自演化多智能体框架 MobileSteward：中心 StewardAgent（Dynamic Recruitment 生成调度图、Adjusted Evaluation 反思/传递信息）+ 多个 App 专属 StaffAgent（Assigned Execution），并以 Memory-based Self-evolution 从成功执行中累积 Staff Expertise / Task Guideline 记忆；在新建 CAPBench(500 条跨 App 指令)上优于单/多智能体基线。

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. Prompted GPT-4v/GPT-4o system: a Steward agent splits a cross-app instruction into an app-level DAG, app-specific Staff agents (AppAgent-style XML+marked screenshots, BM25 top-3 guideline memory) execute, the Steward judges each sub-task with LLM self-evaluation, forwards results along the DAG and writes successful experience into two text memories. Evaluation: authors' CAPBench (500 GPT-4-templated instructions over 14 live apps on an Android Studio emulator; 150 test, the other 350 used for prior self-evolution, memory also updated during test), SAPBench (50) and MobileAgentBench (baseline rows copied from that paper). How 'instruction completed' is adjudicated is never stated; Table 2 and Table 3 disagree on the full GPT-4v Task Rate (0.76 vs 0.81); MobileSteward gets 20 steps x 3 tries per Staff agent while baselines get 80 steps in total; single temperature-0 run. Strongest evidence: module ablations and app-count stratification. Applicable cards/expectations: gui C17/C18/C19; E10, E16, E17, E20, E28, E35.
agreed_items_review: Agreed items M=3, X=2, E.causality=2, E.holdout=1, E.statistics=1, E.cost=2, claim_type system_method, evidence_level online, claim_support scoped were re-checked against the text: all stand; evidence_level carries a provisional note because the success adjudicator is unreported.

gap.remaining_gap: Steward 评估准确率；记忆跨 App/跨基准泛化；与带记忆基线（如 AWM 类）的公平对比；弱模型下的退化。

G.reason: Cross-app dependency/handoff failure is concrete and MobileAgent-v2 is compared, but the gap size rests only on the authors' own benchmark and the self-evolution half is not bounded against existing success-filtered experience memory (AWM; MobileGPT/AutoDroid only named). Real limitation, incomplete nearest-neighbour comparison -> 2.

M.reason: App-level DAG with explicit information flow, per-app specialists and staged evaluation map onto the three named failure sources and yield a testable prediction (advantage grows with app count, Fig 5/Table 5). The LLM self-judgement that gates retries and memory writes is an untested assumption -> 3, not 4.

X.reason: Algorithm, action space, N_try/N_step, BM25 top-3 retrieval are given; prompts, initial expertise contents, the memory-update acceptance rule, retry/stop handling and the ablation configuration are missing.

E.measurement.reason: Success is only defined as 'whether the instruction is completed'; no checker, annotator or judge is described for CAPBench/SAPBench/online users, so verifier trust cannot be assessed; the full-system Task Rate differs between Table 2 and Table 3; MobileAgentBench baselines are copied. Metrics and denominators exist, so not 0.

E.causality.reason: Three module removals and app-count/backbone analyses point the same way, but baselines lack memory, use different budgets and observations, the DAG itself is not ablated, and the ablation configuration is unclear.

E.holdout.reason: Instruction-level split only: memory comes from the other 350 instructions on the same apps/templates and is updated during test; no unseen-app or frozen-memory test.

E.statistics.reason: Test denominator (150) and complexity strata given; single temperature-0 run, no spread, no failure taxonomy; ablation gaps are 7-28 tasks.

E.cost.reason: Actions/task and tokens/action vs MobileAgent-v2 reported, IOT on MobileAgentBench is the highest in its table; no wall-clock or dollars; step/retry budgets differ from baselines.
